name: Movable House
description: A house that can be moved by several links.

fields.name: House Type
fields.description: Selects the house or room model to render.

0.name: House 6x6
0.description: Renders the house model using house_smp.bin and house1_smp.bin.

1.name: Pillar 6x6
1.description: Renders room models using room_smp.bin, room1_smp.bin, room2_smp.bin, and room3_smp.bin.

2.name: Fire Thrower House 6x6
2.description: Renders the house model using house3_smp.bin and house31_smp.bin.

fields.name: Area Geometry
fields.description: Selects the geometry of the registered areas.

0.name: Single Area
0.description: Registers one rectangular area in the upper region.

1.name: Two Upper Areas
1.description: Registers two rectangular areas in the upper region, one on each side.

2.name: Two Lower Areas
2.description: Registers two rectangular areas in the lower region, one on each side.

3.name: No Additional Area
3.description: Does not register an area in this geometry branch.

fields.name: Unknown Value
fields.description: A 5-bit value used to select a matching entry and register associated areas.

fields.name: Move to East Trigger
fields.description: Activates this variable when the house is moved to the east.

fields.name: Move to West Trigger
fields.description: Activates this variable when the house is moved to the west.

fields.name: Move to South Trigger
fields.description: Activates this variable when the house is moved to the south.

fields.name: Move to North Trigger
fields.description: Activates this variable when the house is moved to the north.
